findings.summary: Per-instance gtcSaveChains does not serialize same-hash fallback writes across tabs.
evidence: gtcSaveChains is a module-local Map in cm-gtc-client.js.
The client is loaded per content-script isolated world, so each tab has an independent chain.
Fallback state is shared in chrome.storage.local, allowing an older failure from tab A to write after a newer successful save from tab B.
No existing test covers two independent client instances for the same hash.
findings.requested_action: Require cross-context ordering regression and choose a coordination/versioning design that cannot let late old fallback beat newer successful modern state.
findings.reason_correction_not_authorized: Distinct ADVERSARIAL decision is still required for the protected binding.
